UX architecture principle
Headers should answer 4 questions at a glance: what is this, what's the call, what's the trade, any red flags. All 4 answers fit on 2 rows. Anything deeper belongs inside a sub-tab, not in the header. The redundant SWING/STRATEGY/LEAD-LENS/HORIZON/RULE labeling came from incremental additions over time — each new element wanted its own row · result was bloat. A clean redesign collapses them into one flow.
